create_EuclideanManifold: create a EuclideanManifold instance with optional max_norm and curvature K parameters
compute_EuclideanManifold_distance: compute the squared Euclidean distance between two tensors u and v using the manifold
normalize_EuclideanManifold_vectors: normalize tensor vectors in-place using the manifold's max_norm renorm constraint
compute_EuclideanManifold_expm: compute the exponential map on the Euclidean manifold with optional learning rate and normalization
compute_EuclideanManifold_angle: compute the angle at point u between vectors u and v using the law of cosines
